solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Thought of French being set free

parts.note: de is the French word for 'of'
liberation is the act of being set free

explanation.surface: Someone muses on what it means for the French to be liberated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thought' looks like a verb but is the noun definition at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberation is careful consideration, so it is a synonym for thought as a noun.

clue.text: Club is in district of Washington and capital of Ohio

indicators.note: the word is sits inside the district's letters, so 'in' signals one piece placed within another

parts.note: Washington DC stands in the District of Columbia, abbreviated DC

indicators.note: the capital, or head letter, of the word Ohio is taken

explanation.surface: A tour of American places: a club in Washington and the capital of Ohio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' is not Columbus but the capital letter of Ohio.
explanation.definitionFit: A disco is a nightclub for dancing, so it is one kind of club.

clue.text: I see what you're saying!

parts.note: normally an expression of understanding, read literally it is someone who watches speech rather than hears it

explanation.surface: An everyday exclamation of understanding in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: Taken literally, the speaker sees the words being spoken, reading them off the speaker's mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: A lip-reader understands speech by watching mouth movements, literally seeing what is said.

clue.text: Both chess players going to extremes

definitions.meaning: the two sides in chess are called ...
a ... view sees only extremes, with no shades of grey

explanation.surface: Two chess opponents both playing wild, all-or-nothing chess.
explanation.definitionFit: Chess sides are named Black and White, and black-and-white thinking admits only opposite extremes.

clue.text: Drop awful crude joke, finally

indicators.note: something awful is badly done, so the letters of crude are rearranged
finally points to the last letter of joke

explanation.surface: Advice to abandon a tasteless, vulgar joke.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce something is to lower or decrease it, a sense of the verb drop.

clue.text: People in the Bible destroying Satan with holiness

indicators.note: destroying suggests wrecking the words Satan and holiness so their letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Biblical people defeating the devil through their piety.
explanation.definitionFit: The Thessalonians, citizens of Thessalonica, received two of Paul's epistles in the New Testament.

clue.text: Unit giving nothing to Her Majesty

parts.note: O, the round zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: A gift of nothing presented to the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: The ohm is the SI unit of electrical resistance.

clue.text: Notice working? Exactly!

parts.note: to spot something is to notice it
a machine that is on is working

explanation.surface: Someone checks a machine is working and gets an emphatic yes.
explanation.definitionFit: Spot on is a British idiom meaning precisely right, the same as replying 'Exactly!'.

clue.text: Reddish-brown colour one's seen in mushy peas

indicators.note: one is seen inside the scrambled peas, so it goes within them
mushy peas are mashed up, so the letters of peas are scrambled

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: A brownish tint spotted in a bowl of mushy peas, a British chip-shop side dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mushy' rearranges PEAS into SEPA, and 'seen in' puts I inside it. Mushy peas are mashed marrowfat peas served with fish and chips in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepia is the reddish-brown pigment, originally from cuttlefish ink, seen in old photographs.

clue.text: Imagine extraordinary red feline returning

indicators.note: extraordinary suggests something out of its usual order, so red is rearranged
returning means the feline's name is read backwards

parts.note: a puma is a big cat, a feline

explanation.surface: Picture an amazing red cat coming back home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extraordinary' turns RED into DRE, and 'returning' reverses PUMA into AMUP.
explanation.definitionFit: To dream up is to invent or conceive in the mind, which is to imagine.

clue.text: Money trimmed, small figure

indicators.note: trimmed means the word money loses its edges, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A tight budget, with only a small sum left over.
explanation.definitionFit: One is the lowest positive whole number, so it is a small figure.

clue.text: Gives up prostitute, getting shot in the arm

parts.note: to kick a habit is to give it up
tart is slang for a prostitute

explanation.surface: A tale of someone quitting a prostitute and taking a drug injection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot in the arm' suggests an injection but means a boost.
explanation.definitionFit: A kick-start is a sudden boost to get things going, the idiomatic sense of a shot in the arm.

clue.text: Burrowing animal, or llama I'd cooked!

indicators.note: something cooked is changed from its raw form, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A choice of dinner: a burrowing creature or the llama I prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: The armadillo is an armoured mammal of the Americas that digs burrows.

clue.text: Short day in warmer African country

indicators.note: the shortened day goes inside the warmer, so 'in' signals insertion

parts.note: the sun is what warms the earth

indicators.note: short means the word day loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A brief, hot day spent in an African country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'warmer' looks like an adjective but is a noun, the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Sudan is a nation in north-east Africa, south of Egypt.

clue.text: Pelt despicable group

definitions.meaning: to pelt or ... is to rain down heavily or bombard
in British slang a ... is a useless or contemptible bunch of people

explanation.surface: Pelting a contemptible gang with missiles.
explanation.definitionFit: Shower means to pour down like rain, and is British slang for a worthless bunch, as in 'what a shower'.

clue.text: Fruit gobbled up by little mongrel

indicators.note: the fruit is swallowed inside the words little mongrel, so its letters are found within them

explanation.surface: A small mutt wolfing down a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon is a sour yellow citrus fruit.

clue.text: Barium processed in Italian region

indicators.note: processed means the letters of barium are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A chemical element being treated in a part of Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Umbria is a landlocked region of central Italy, home to Perugia and Assisi.

clue.text: Extraordinary row with Samoan rower

indicators.note: extraordinary suggests things out of their normal order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remarkable argument with a Samoan rower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' looks like rowing, but here it is just letters, perhaps a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: An oarswoman is a woman who rows a boat, a female rower.

clue.text: Days in March initially quite dark

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: Days in early spring being fairly gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dim means lacking light, somewhat dark rather than pitch black.

clue.text: Some mistake by ambassador reversed, perhaps

indicators.note: reversed means the letters taken are then read backwards
some means only part of the words mistake by ambassador is used

explanation.surface: A diplomatic blunder, possibly undone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes EBYAM from 'mistakE BY AMbassador', and 'reversed' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Maybe and perhaps are synonymous adverbs expressing possibility.

clue.text: Before noble, one queen

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, Queen Elizabeth

explanation.surface: Royal precedence: before the nobleman comes a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier as an adverb means at a previous time, the temporal sense of before.

clue.text: Eggs for two people, ultimately

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: Breakfast eggs being cooked for a couple.
explanation.definitionFit: Roe is the mass of eggs in a female fish.

clue.text: In need of opening, kitchen passage

indicators.note: lacking an opening, the kitchen word loses its first letter

parts.note: a galley is the kitchen on a ship or aircraft

explanation.surface: A cramped kitchen corridor whose door needs opening.
explanation.definitionFit: An alley is a narrow passageway between buildings.

clue.text: Shop offering drunk ale, no regrets!

indicators.note: drunk suggests these words are reeling about, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shop selling beer that nobody will regret drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' looks like it describes the ale but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A general store is a shop selling a wide range of goods, typically in a small community.
